products.name: DP Trainer Kit: Manaphy & Lucario
products.note: Two half decks, Manaphy (12 different cards) and Lucario (11), each with a holofoil Pokémon in new art (Manaphy 4, Lucario 3), plus one booster pack of a late EX-series or Diamond & Pearl set, damage and status counters, a Manaphy coin and a playmat. The pack is not simulated, and the copies of each card a half deck held are not on record, so opening the kit from either half-deck page deals one of each different card of both decks.
products.priceSource: The kit's own TCGplayer listing has no price; priced at its 23 different cards' market prices added up, one of each (a floor: the real decks held more copies).
